learnings.text: NTFS-locked files on C:\opencodes: fix with icacls /grant:r user:F /T then .NET File.Delete; Remove-Item fails on NonInteractive prompts

C:\\opencodes NTFS: file create/read OK but delete/rename denied. Git dies at tmp_obj rename. Fix: git repack -a -d, build fresh separate-git-dir from pack+refs+config, rewrite .git pointer with Set-Content -Force. Never rely on unlink; use overwrite-in-place.

learnings.pattern: Greedy regex groups with re.S in parsers backtrack to minimal capture - always test parser output count vs file count
NTFS fault blocks git rm AND .NET File.Delete on C:\opencodes - takeown/A + icacls grant SID:F + attrib clear then delete works without admin
Cross-links relative depth: sibling in same category needs ../name/, different category ../../cat/name/ from skills/cat/name/SKILL.md
